definitions.explanation: Two children born at the same birth.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{双子|ふたご}の{母親|ははおや}だ。
examples.english: She is a mother of twins.

examples.japanese: {双子|ふたご}なのに{全然|ぜんぜん}{似|に}ていない。
examples.english: Even though they're twins, they don't look alike at all.

examples.japanese: {一卵性|いちらんせい}{双生児|そうせいじ}は{遺伝子|いでんし}が{同|おな}じだ。
examples.english: Identical twins have the same genes.
examples.notes: 一卵性双生児 = identical twins (formal)

notes:
USAGE: {双子|ふたご} is the common word for twins. The more formal/medical term is {双生児|そうせいじ}.

TYPES:
・{一卵性|いちらんせい}{双生児|そうせいじ} (identical twins)
・{二卵性|にらんせい}{双生児|そうせいじ} (fraternal twins)

RELATED:
・{三つ子|みつご} (triplets)
・{四つ子|よつご} (quadruplets)

ASTROLOGY: {双子座|ふたござ} = Gemini (zodiac sign)
